conviction_note: A J-REIT whose DPU is set by reserve draws (2,700 guided for Aug-2026 and Feb-2027 against cruise ~2,450-2,465) and whose last five prints moved -1.04 to +0.12; the only real new item is the first Aug-2027 guide, which the depleting reserve (256m yen, ~253 yen/unit after Feb-2027) and the June BOJ hike tilt slightly negative, but a 7.15% yield and a -21% year already price that, so p_up 47 on an abs move of 0.8 gives -0.05, about the same size as the findings' sum of -0.05.
bar: Company DPU forecast 2,700 yen for FP Aug-2026 and 2,700 for FP Feb-2027, EPU forecast 2,504 / 2,517, from the 2026-04-20 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260420/140120260420506374.pdf (unchanged since the 2026-02-13 revision https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260213/140120260213562054.pdf; the 2026-09-29 asset swap notice says no revision). No 四季報/IFIS figure sourced for the new Aug-2027 period, so the guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 0.87% of units (1 seller), down from 0.90% (covering slightly), as of 2026-10-22 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via baseline). 信用倍率 543x (kabutan 2026-10-23 shows the same 543倍): margin long crowded, almost no margin short, so no squeeze fuel and a retail long that sells on disappointment. No option skew exists. priced_lean_pct -0.594, run-up 20d -3.82%, 5d -1.43%. Holder flows public: BlackRock cut below 5% (2026-09-04), MUFG crossed 5% (2026-08-18), Fidelity increased (2026-08-07).

findings.finding: The DPU of 2,700 for Aug-2026 and Feb-2027 is held only by drawing ~198m and ~184m yen from a reserve that falls to 256m yen (~253 yen/unit) after Feb-2027, against cruise DPU of 2,465/2,452, and the BOJ raised to 1.0% in June 2026 after the February forecast (which assumed 905m/925m yen of interest and fees); the first Aug-2027 guide published with this release can hold 2,700 only by exhausting the reserve, so a guide below 2,700 is the more likely surprise direction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2025 print (Aug-2025 DPU 2,780 vs 2,700 guided plus new Feb-2026 guide) -1.04% next session; Apr 2026 print (new Feb-2027 guide at 2,700) -0.45%; Feb-2026 revision with offering -0.95% (Yahoo daily bars).
findings.why_not_priced: The reserve arithmetic is public since April, so most of it is held: the unit is -21% over the year against -17% for the J-REIT ETF 1343 and yields 7.15%. What is not priced is the specific Aug-2027 number, which no one has seen; if the market had fully priced a cut, the yield gap to peers would already be closed and holders would not be crowded long on margin at 543x.
findings.independence: BOJ June 2026 hike to 1.0% (snippet_only, https://www.am.mufg.jp/report/special/special_260616.pdf); interest assumptions in the 2026-02-13 revision notice https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260213/140120260213562054.pdf. Both are inputs, not a company statement about Aug-2027.

findings.finding: Hotel variable rents ran at records (ACCESS by LOISIR HOTEL Nagoya +14.0% to record sales, Quintessa Sapporo inbound-driven) and this REIT paid above its DPU guide the last time a summer period closed (Aug-2025: 2,780 vs 2,700), so Aug-2026 actual EPU/DPU is likely at or a little above the 2,504/2,700 forecast, with any excess more likely retained than paid.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Aug-2025 beat (+80 yen DPU) printed -1.04% next session: beats on this line have been sold or ignored.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the hotel strength was disclosed in April. The Aug-2026 hotel numbers have not been published (no monthly KPI series from this REIT), so the size of the period beat is unseen; but the retention policy means a beat mostly refills the reserve, which is why it is small.
findings.independence: 2026-02-13 revision raised Feb-2026 DPU 2,700 -> 2,800 and actual came in at 2,800 with EPU 2,847 vs 2,814 forecast (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260420/140120260420506374.pdf): same issuer, different document.

findings.finding: The 2026-09-29 swap (buy Luxena Kamimaezu 1,867m yen, sell Rockfield Nishi-Oi 578m yen with a ~23m yen gain, ~23 yen/unit in Feb-2027) is stated by the company to have minor impact with no forecast revision.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: public for a month and inside the company's stated no-revision outlook. Filed because it is a sourced fact bearing on the Feb-2027 line, sized at zero.

outside_window.finding: Reserve exhaustion after Feb-2027 makes the cruise DPU (~2,450) the binding level from FP Feb-2028 unless gains on sale or the 3,500 mid-term target materialise.

searched_and_found_nothing: kabutan disclosure list 2025-07 to 2026-10-23 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3492&nmode=3): no 分配金予想の修正 or 業績予想の修正 since 2026-02-13, no 自己投資口取得 ever
company IR top page https://mirarth-reit.com/ (curl 200): only a 2026-10-22 notice suspending web updates over a PHP vulnerability, which points readers to TDnet for the 10/23 results; benign
presentation 2026-04-20 and measures page: no mention of 自己投資口 / buyback policy, so a buyback with this release has no sourced precedent
no 四季報/IFIS DPU estimate for Aug-2027 found

release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3492&b=n202610221159 (kabutan lists 3492 for 10/23 with 前回16:00; the 2025-10-22 and 2026-04-20 決算短信 were both stamped 16:00 on kabutan's disclosure list)
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: no prior revision filed; Feb-2027 2,700 likely held or nudged. Returns: no buyback history, none expected on evidence. New-period guide: Aug-2027 DPU is new and is the main item, at risk below 2,700 as the reserve runs out. Quarter: Aug-2026 DPU vs 2,700, history of paying at or slightly above guide (2,780 vs 2,700 in Aug-2025).

rejected_candidates.candidate: Holder flows: BlackRock below 5%, MUFG above 5%, Fidelity increasing
rejected_candidates.detail: Dated August-September large-holding reports; they describe positioning already carried in positioning_check, not a print item; filed there rather than as a finding.
The page's 2026-09-17 is its crawl date; the document is the 2026-02-13 revision, and the kabutan TDnet list shows no revision after it.

baseline_tension: The small negative agrees with the negative lean (-0.59) and the -3.8% run-up, so it is mostly priced; the strongest positive the release could carry is a held 2,700 for Aug-2027 (relief on a 7.15% yield) or a first buyback at roughly 0.7x NAV, and I looked for buyback precedent and found none.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on public series): the reserve arithmetic is public since April, so the guidance negative was cut from -0.3 to -0.2 and p_up moved from 46 to 47; kept because the release ADDS the Aug-2027 guide.
Rule 2 (check the sign): wrote the strongest positive (held 2,700 / buyback) into baseline_tension; I had looked for a buyback, so p_up was not moved further.
